register.reg_condition: when FEAT_ECV_POFF is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Holds the 64-bit physical offset. This is the offset for the AArch64 EL1 physical timer and counter when Enhanced Counter Virtualization is enabled.

listitem.content: Direct reads of CNTPCT_EL0 from EL0 or EL1.
Indirect reads of the physical counter by the EL1 physical timer. See 'The Generic Timer in AArch64 state'.
Indirect reads of the physical counter for timestamps generated by profiling logic. See 'The Statistical Profiling Extension' and 'AArch64 Self-hosted Trace'.

configuration_text.para: The physical offset only applies under conditions described by the relevant sections.
If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.
